meta.description: Wing Staff is comprised of the Wing Command staff, Command Post, Inspector General, Safety, Public Affairs, Judge Advocate General, Chaplain Corps, and the Comptroller Flight (Finance). All offices are administrative in nature. Safety and Public Affairs are required to work on the flightline and around moving equipment/aircraft.
meta.references:
DAFI 91-202 - The Department of the Air Force (DAF) Mishap Prevention Program Dept of the Air Force Mishap Prevention Program
DAFMAN 91-203 - Air Force Occupational Safety, Fire and Health Standards Dept of the Air Force Consolidated Fire, Safety, and Occupational Health
meta.emergencyNumbers:
Call 911 from land line and cell phones.
NOTE: WHEN CALLING FROM A CELL PHONE, SPECIFY EXACT LOCATION (139TH AIRFLIT WING) The dispatcher will know to dispatch 139th Fire Department instead of Doniphan or Buchanan County Fire & EMS.
meta.medicalFacility:
Mosaic Life Care Medical Center
909 Heartland Rd, St. Joseph 64507

139 Fire Department will render first aid and basic EMS services until ambulance arrives.
meta.evacuationRoute:
Muster Point: East parking lot adjacent to main gate guard shack.

Evacuation Routes are along each main hallway. One exit in each stairwell, FSS Conference Room, outside HR office, main hallway (facing flightline and rear exit near IG office), and one emergency exit is inside the command post (accessible only by occupants of the command post).
meta.shelterInPlace:
Storm Shelters: Center hallways marked near top of walls (stay away from front glass entryway.

Lockdown: Shelter in place and lock office doors.
meta.activeShooterMethods: Lockdown: If you cannot run, lock office doors, shut off lights, get low, stay quiet. Use basic principle of Run, Hide, Fight. Call 911 and report location of shooter.
meta.adverseWeatherShelter:
Stay indoors during lightning warnings and severe weather such as strong winds and hail.
Use severe weather locations during tornado warnings.
Reference evacuation map for more locations.
meta.fireEquipmentNotes: Locations of fire extinguishers, pull stations, and AED located on emergency evacuation map.
meta.safetyBoardLocation: In main hallway outside Wing Safety Office/Room 158
meta.trafficSafetyNotes:
This unit isn't required to operate any vehicle that requires anything other than a state issued driver's license. 
Base speed limit is 20mph. Hands free device usage only while operating a vehicle.
Be aware of pedestrian traffic on and off base.
Be cautious of cross traffic on K-238.
meta.trafficContacts: See Wing Safety Office for all motorcycle and other traffic safety information.

selectedModules.title: Flight Line Driving
selectedModules.reference: DAFMAN 91-203 - Air Force Occupational Safety, Fire and Health Standards, Chapter 24
selectedModules.trainingRequirement: Provide local flight line driving rules, markings, vehicle lighting requirements, restricted areas, and aircraft hazard awareness before granting driving privileges.
selectedModules.afTrainingRequirement: Use installation or unit-approved training and certification for airfield/fight line operations, to include local speed, spotter, and no-lone-zone requirements.
selectedModules.afTrainingBasis: DAFMAN 91-203 / Aircraft Flight Line – Ground Operations and Activities
selectedModules.notes: Flightline driving is administered by the Airfield Management Office.

selectedModules.title: Active Shooter Response
selectedModules.reference: Installation emergency management guidance / local procedures
selectedModules.trainingRequirement: Brief personnel on how to recognize an active shooter event, how to summon help, and how to apply local run-hide-fight guidance based on the facility layout.
selectedModules.afTrainingRequirement: Use local emergency response procedures, shelter locations, and mass notification methods applicable to the duty location.
